title: PixelKin - Jest-House Boss (The Headline Act)
_note: The Old Light's top-floor boss cue (oldlight_headliners: Punchwheel's three tin lamplighters, before Tam's card). It is the BOSS theme (battle-boss-eclipse, 176 BPM, D minor, 36 bars) clowning around, the way battle-jesthouse is the wild theme clowning around: the boss's saw lead kept NOTE FOR NOTE (extracted from the .mid) on a honky pulse25, so it reads as a real boss fight, but the pumping eighth bass becomes a galloping oom-pah (root on 1, fifth on 3), the strings become offbeat brass pah-stabs, a calliope arp runs the chords, claps sit on the backbeat, and every gap in the lead's riff bars gets a gag in turn: the tower's ha-ha laugh glides, or a two-note tritone bicycle-horn honk. Slide whistles up/down every 8 bars, crash on each section top, a pfft at the 12- and 36-bar cadences and a high bell ding closing each section. 176 BPM, D minor -> E minor -> D minor. snes register on the chip engine; classic-only like every battle cue.
